subject: Planned maintenance: graceful handoff validation + warmup opt-in
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samuel Kim <samuel.kim@clearskyanalytics.com>, support@clearskyanalytics.com
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jun 2028 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Planned maintenance: graceful handoff validation + warmup opt-in

Hi Samuel / ClearSky team,

We're planning a short, region-scoped maintenance exercise in eastus3 to validate a graceful handoff path and confirm our KV-cache preservation heuristics. This is a precautionary maintenance to finalize a driver compatibility patch and to validate our canary handoffs before a wider rollout.

Planned window (proposed):
- Start: 2028-06-29 02:00 UTC
- End: 2028-06-29 04:00 UTC
- Region: eastus3 (inbound traffic routed normally; we'll perform rolling restarts of serving hosts)

What to expect:
- Canary stage (10% of traffic) for the first 30 minutes, then staged ramp.
- Targeted rolling restarts per rack to avoid full-region restart.
- Short latency blips (100-400ms) possible for some requests during host handoffs; rare 502s during failover recovery (expected <= 60s per affected host).
- KV-cache rehydration may occur for caches not preserved; we've added warmup hooks to minimize regen.

Actions for ClearSky (recommended):
1) Opt-in for priority warmups: reply with the single word OPT-IN and we'll add pre-warm tokens for your tenancy during canary and ramp phases.
2) If you have critical jobs running in the window (batch jobs, ETL), reply with the job window and we can look at shifting the maintenance by up to 4 hours.
3) If you need evidence for compliance, see the attached SOC2 summary and the link below; we can run an evidence call if you prefer.

Attachments: maintenance_runbook_v1.pdf (runbook stub), warmup_instructions.md
Links: https://drive.redwoodinference.com/teams/ops/shared/maintenance-runbook-2028-06-25

We'll hold the window tentative for 48 hours to gather feedback from customers. Please reply by EOD Thu 2028-06-27 with OPT-IN / OPT-OUT / request to reschedule. If you opt in, include any IP ranges or subnets you want pinned for warmup traffic.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-minute call to walk through details.

Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Subject: Re: Planned maintenance: graceful handoff validation + warmup opt-in

On Tue, 25 Jun 2028 at 15:02, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> We're planning a short, region-scoped maintenance exercise in eastus3 to validate a graceful handoff path and confirm our KV-cache preservation heuristics.

Thanks for the heads up, Jordan. ClearSky would like to OPT-IN for the priority warmups — we rely on short-lived session performance for our interactive product. A few questions/requests before we confirm:

- Can you shift the window later by ~2 hours? We have nightly ETL and backup jobs that peak 03:00–04:00 UTC. A 02:00–04:00 window would overlap with that.
- Will Dedicated/Dedicated-reserved instances be touched by this exercise, or only shared hosted pools? We need confirmation because our Dedicated deployment should not be disrupted.
- Please attach the SOC2 report (or the redacted summary) for our security team; they requested a quick read.

Ticket: CS-18923 (for tracking)

If you can provide the answers above and offer a 15-min prep call, we'll lock in OPT-IN.

—Sam
Samuel Kim
Head of Platform Ops, ClearSky Analytics
samuel.kim@clearskyanalytics.com | +1 (206) 555-0133
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 26 Jun 2028 02:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Planned maintenance: graceful handoff validation + warmup opt-in

Hi Sam — thanks, and absolutely.

Quick answers:
- Shift: we can offer two alternative windows if the original conflicts: 06:00–08:00 UTC or 22:00–00:00 UTC on 2028-06-29. I attached reschedule_options.ics with both options. Please tell us which you'd prefer and we'll reserve the slot.
- Impact on Dedicated: this exercise will NOT touch Dedicated-reserved pools. We will only target shared hosted capacity in eastus3. If you are on a Dedicated pool, there should be no restart impacting your tenancy.
- SOC2: attached soc2_summary.pdf (redacted). Full report available under NDA; we can arrange an evidence call with engineering security.

If ClearSky confirms OPT-IN and selects the 06:00–08:00 UTC slot we'll also schedule a 15-minute prep call 24 hours before the window to validate warmup hooks and pinned IPs.

Attachments: soc2_summary.pdf, reschedule_options.ics, canary_plan.csv
